name: BRO-Personal-Ai
description: Personal AI command desk. Live public GitHub, live ORE SOL and USDC marks, and a free-router ask. No orders.

paragraphs: BRO is a personal AI command desk. The public page on GitHub Pages reads live data in the browser and answers through a free router. It does not send trades, it does not hold API keys, and it does not pretend a local rule is a cloud model.

This repository is the static desk. A fuller command centre, with an xAI queen, a signing gate, and a model roster, can run on a server. That server is not what GitHub Pages hosts. The pages below say which surface does which job, so a reader can tell a live fetch from a label.
These calls leave the browser. They use public endpoints. They do not use a token from this repo.
features: It cannot call xAI. Grok 4.5 and Grok 4.6 stay on a server that holds XAIAPIKEY.
It cannot call FreeLLMAPI. That router is local, at a /v1 you run, and it wants FREELLMAPIURL plus FREELLMAPIKEY.
It cannot place an order on an exchange. There is no wallet, no transaction, and no "confirm trade" button.
It cannot see private GitHub data, Slack, a calendar account, or a bank.
It cannot speak with a paid voice, draw an image, or render a clip. Those benches exist only where a server key is present.
